name: factorio-optimizer-exporter
title: Factorio optimizer data exporter
author: Filip Hostinský
description: Writes script-output/factorio-optimizer-data.json for factorio_optimizer: recipes, items, fluids, quality, crafting machines with their fluid boxes, and belts, inserters, poles and pipes, for the base game and any mods loaded with it. It runs by itself a moment after a game starts, or with the console command /export_optimizer_data.
